name: What is the difference between long-term and short-term (vacation) rental investments in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between long-term and short-term (vacation) rental investments in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Long-term rentals typically offer more stable, predictable income and lower tenant turnover, while short-term vacation rentals often yield higher nightly rates but come with increased management demands, fluctuating occupancy, and potential local regulations, such as those in Miami Beach or Kissimmee. Investors should consider their involvement level and risk tolerance. Kelby Contreras helps clients evaluate the pros and cons of each type in specific Florida submarkets to align with their investment strategy and lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Long-term rentals offer stability, while short-term vacation rentals yield higher rates with more management and regulation. Kelby Contreras helps investors compare options based on their goals.
